decisions.reason: The revised Payment and Milestone Schedule changes a proposal table, not the narrative content, section order, or Section 2 subsection state.
Adding rows to the Payment and Milestone Schedule does not change the cover letter's page count, signature, or image-relocation requirements.
The table revision supplies changed table content but does not alter the existing full-document layout or graphic-treatment requirements.
The revised schedule table does not change any proposal photo selection, placement, or cropping requirement.
The table-content revision does not change the Agua Arc identity or brand assets applied to the proposal.
Adding rows to the schedule table does not modify the requirement that hyperlinks remain functional.
The revised table does not change the final file count, PDF format, email submission method, or export-quality requirements.
Supplying a revised table through the Google document does not change Canva ownership, edit access, asset policy, or source-file delivery requirements.
The source requests inclusion of a revised table but establishes no new deadline, turnaround time, or revision schedule.
Although the added rows may consume space, the source does not change the applicable page-limit goal or the required response if the proposal cannot fit.
The revised table is an item to address within the existing revision round and does not change the round count or its established trigger.
The source concerns the separate GreenLatinos RFQ and has no effect on the TPEC proposal design requirement.
